attackers_goals: An adversary may create, assign or modify a role to elevate the permissions of other user accounts and persist in their target's environment.
description: A Google Workspace identity created, assigned or modified a delegated admin role.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection
investigative_actions: Check if the identity intended to perform this action or look for signs that the user account is compromised (e.g. abnormal logins, unusual activity). Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Follow further actions done by the account.
